name: Time
description: The current date and time on this computer, and date arithmetic: days between two dates, or a date some days or months away. Needs no network.

functions.name: time_now
functions.description: Get the current date, time, day of the week and UTC offset of this computer. Give utc_offset to see the time at another offset.

utc_offset.description: Optional offset such as '+05:30' or '-04:00'. Default: this computer's

functions.name: date_calc
functions.description: Date arithmetic: the date some days or months from a date, or the number of days between two dates, with the day of the week.

date.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today on this computer

add_days.description: Days to add; negative goes back

add_months.description: Months to add; negative goes back. A day past the month's end becomes its last day

until.description: An end date as YYYY-MM-DD, to count the days from date to it
